question: The difference between the smallest and the largest fractions among (5)/(6),(7)/(8),(11)/(12),(13)/(16) is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

By making the denominator same we have,

⇒ 120/144, 126/144, 132/144, 117/144

Out of the above numbers the greatest is 132/144 and smallest is 117/144

Difference will be:

⇒ (132 - 117)/144

⇒ (15)/144

⇒ (5)/48

∴ The correct answer is (5)/(48)
